workflows.name: Validate before advancing the application
workflows.statement: Run registered field and page checks before saving; remain with errors if validation fails.

workflows.name: Save before completing a form page
workflows.statement: Await the configured save before advancing; preserve answers and show recovery guidance if saving fails.

workflows.name: Allow an intermediate step before navigation
workflows.statement: An optional page callback can hold navigation after saving and resume it later.

workflows.name: Prevent repeated Next actions during submission
workflows.statement: Disable Next during submission or when the page disables it; show loading during transitions.
